description: We’re Orbitrace, four students passionate about physics, aerospace and AI. For NASA’s Flame in Freefall challenge, we built AETHER-BURN X, an interactive platform that explores NASA microgravity combustion research, compares experimental conditions and investigates spacecraft fire-safety scenarios. Our evidence-grounded research assistant traces findings to scientific sources, flags uncertainty and identifies research gaps. We welcome skills in computational physics, Python, ML and UI/UX.
